title: CRDs: extending the cluster API with your own object

videos.script: Every object in this course so far was one Kubernetes already knew: pods, Services, Deployments. The API is not a fixed list. {{fixed}} A CustomResourceDefinition teaches the API server a new kind of object, with a name, a schema and validation, and from then on it is stored, listed and watched like any other. {{crd}} You will define a Backup object for the shop's database, create one, watch the API server refuse a bad one, and then notice the one thing a CRD does not give you. {{plan}} It stores what you want. It does nothing about it. That is the next lesson. {{nothing}}
